meta.title: About INNOXONE | Young Kim & Personal Golf Mobility
meta.description: Meet the people and ideas behind INNOXONE. Discover Young Kim’s design story, hear from an INNO-F1 owner, and visit our Golf Gallery in California.

hero.label: About INNOXONE
headline: A better choice.
For better golf.
hero.text: We’re a California golf mobility company. We design personal electric golf carts around the people who play.

founder.name: Young Kim
founder.role: Founder of INNOXONE · Designer of INNO-F1
founder.headline: Good design starts with people.
paragraphs: Young Kim’s work at INNODESIGN spans everyday electronics and the torch and cauldron for the PyeongChang 2018 Winter Olympics. Different products, with people at the center.
His lifelong interest in cars brought that thinking to golf. He asked a simple question: why should two golfers, playing two different balls, always share one ride?

purpose.label: The idea behind INNO-F1
headline: Start with one golfer.
Design around them.
purpose.text: A seat of your own. Your clubs close by. The freedom to go to your ball and prepare for your next shot.
purpose.closing: INNO-F1 puts that idea into a single-rider electric golf cart. You still share the round, with your own way around the course.

owner.quote: I can go right to my ball.
owner.name: Harold
owner.text: Harold traveled from Arizona to California to try INNO-F1. In his own words, having a cart to himself means getting to his ball and keeping his attention on his next shot.

headline: One idea.
More ways to move.
future.text: Our vision reaches beyond a single model: personal vehicles, more choice for golfers, and better ways for course teams to work.
future.robo: Walk or Ride. The Choice Is Yours. Our next family of personal golf mobility is coming to the 2027 Orlando PGA Show.
future.connect: INNOXONE CONNECT brings golfers, vehicles and course teams into one vision for intelligent mobility and Physical AI.

visit.label: San Juan Capistrano, California
headline: Our story has a home.
You’re invited.
visit.text: Visit the INNOXONE Golf Gallery to see the vehicles and the thinking behind them. Meet our team, ask your questions and arrange a test ride.
visit.note: Contact us to confirm a visit, demonstration and model availability.
